actions.reason: C0001 shows a coherent, multiplicity-adjusted RNA phenotype (immune/inflammatory up, heme metabolism down) with broad cross-modal membership support and no significant technical confounder; structural separation from C0002 is weak but positive and no reproducible internal subdivision or insufficient-separation evidence is present, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation despite residual uncertainty from near-zero silhouettes and RNA-only pathway support.
